item.description:

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.42)] Apple has been ordered to pay a record $5.7 billion in a case concerning a patent for haptic feedback technology
item.description:

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.43)] US jury says Apple owes record $5.7 billion in haptic technology patent case
item.description:
